title: Fox dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M30,72 Q10,60 12,42 Q14,30 24,34 Q20,50 38,62 Z" fill="#e8701a"/>
  <path d="M12,42 Q14,30 24,34 Q22,44 20,46 Q16,44 12,42 Z" fill="#faf0d0"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="42" y="74" width="6" height="18" rx="3" fill="#c85a10"/>
  <rect x="54" y="74" width="6" height="18" rx="3" fill="#c85a10"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="93" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#5a2a08"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="93" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#5a2a08"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#f08c28"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#fdf0d5"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d="M32,54 Q20,46 16,36" stroke="#e8701a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M68,54 Q80,46 84,36" stroke="#e8701a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <path d="M50,16 L34,38 Q50,30 66,38 Z" fill="#f08c28"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="17" fill="#f08c28"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d="M37,26 L32,12 L44,22 Z" fill="#f08c28"/>
  <path d="M63,26 L68,12 L56,22 Z" fill="#f08c28"/>
  <path d="M38,24 L35,16 L43,22 Z" fill="#5a2a08"/>
  <path d="M62,24 L65,16 L57,22 Z" fill="#5a2a08"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <path d="M50,48 Q40,42 38,46 Q37,50 44,52 Q50,54 56,52 Q63,50 62,46 Q60,42 50,48 Z" fill="#fdf0d5"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="38" rx="3.2" ry="4" fill="#2a1400"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="38" rx="3.2" ry="4" fill="#2a1400"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="36.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="36.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#2a1400"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47,50 Q50,53 53,50" stroke="#2a1400" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ffb070" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ffb070" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d="M22,24 L24,18 L26,24 L24,22 Z" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <path d="M78,20 L80,14 L82,20 L80,18 Z" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <path d="M84,50 L86,45 L88,50 L86,48 Z" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
</svg>
